standard-dialogue-before-starting-while-.player: Hello there. What do you do here?

standard-dialogue-before-starting-while-.npc: Ah, I'm just keeping an eye on things and making sure nothing untoward happens.
One day I hope it will be.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-wh.npc: Ah, [player name], it's good to see you again.

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-wh.player: Hello there, Thaerisk. Any word on Lucien?

standard-dialogue-after-completion-of-wh.npc: Nothing yet, but we're doing everything we can to find him. I hope he's ready for us, because once we do locate him, we're going to give him quite the bloody nose...
... or at least whatever passes for a nose on a Mahjarrat!
